replace: const aiTicks = Object.values(ticksByGroup).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
why: Divides every per-profile rate by the whole run's AI-ticks instead of that profile's own. This is the dilution issue #908 exists to remove: over seeds 1-40 at 1800 ticks the five reachable profiles own 12.4% to 26.6% of the measurable ticks, so a pooled denominator understates a single-profile change four- to eight-fold -- and it does it quietly, because every row still looks like a rate.
killedBy: groupRows divides each group by its OWN AI-ticks, not by the run total
